request: Formally verify the existing deep counter RTL with an unbounded proof.
expected_behavior: A property file and a single-task SymbiYosys setup for the approved deep_counter RTL (count 0 to LIMIT, default 99, with enable, synchronous clear and a carry out on the wrapping cycle), written from the approved interface specification, whose properties are inductive, so a prove-mode run (k-induction) proves them for every cycle with a short unrolling and reaches every cover, and that fails on RTL that goes wrong only 64 or more cycles after reset.
constraints: Work only from the approved interface specification and the approved RTL; never change the RTL or ship a file of the same name.
Prove in prove mode at the default LIMIT; a bounded model check is not a proof, and its gate refuses it.
Use the SVA subset open Yosys reads: immediate assertions, assumptions and covers in always blocks, with $past; no implication or sequence operators.
known_failure_modes: A bounded check (mode bmc) a few dozen cycles deep: it never sees a wrap or the top bit, so every mutant here passes it; the proof gate refuses it because nothing is proven.
Properties that are true but not inductive, so induction fails on the approved RTL and the proof never reaches review.
Properties that only bound the count (never above LIMIT), so a count that loses its carry into the top bit, and stays in range, passes.
A proof whose unrolling is deep enough to reach a wrap but whose covers or assumptions stop the counter from counting.
A proof that cannot tell a lost carry, a compare that ignores bit 0, a wrap to 1 or a count that stops at LIMIT from the approved RTL; the must-fail control fails it.

held_out.name: The seat's proof passes the approved RTL with every cover reached and fails each deep counter mutant
